title: Chapter 7 — The AI-Assisted Appliance Salesperson
intro: How AI fits into appliance retail — what it does well and what it must never do.

sections.title: Rule One: Verify Everything
sections.content:
AI tools can generate product comparisons, draft follow-up emails, research competitive positioning, and help you prep for customer conversations faster than you ever could alone. But they get things wrong. Plausible-but-incorrect specs become YOUR incorrect specs the moment you share them with a customer.

The rule is non-negotiable: verify every fact against the source before it ships. Model numbers, dimensions, prices, features — check them against the manufacturer spec sheet or the PIM. An AI that says a Bosch 500 series dishwasher runs at 40 dBA when it actually runs at 44 dBA just made you look like you do not know your products.

AI is your research assistant, not your answer key.

sections.title: What AI Does Well
sections.content:
AI excels at speed and breadth. Use it to draft follow-up emails in seconds instead of minutes. Use it to compare three products across twenty specs without building a spreadsheet by hand. Use it to research a brand you have never sold before — get the selling angles, the competitive positioning, the warranty structure.

It is excellent for practicing objection handling. Ask it to be the customer. Practice your response. It will push back harder than most real customers, which makes you better.

It is excellent for CRM leverage. Upload your pipeline and ask it to identify patterns — which quotes are going stale, which customers are due for a follow-up, which deals have the highest close probability.

sections.title: What AI Must Never Do
sections.content:
AI must never replace your judgment on the floor. It cannot read the customer's body language. It cannot feel the energy shift when you mention a price. It cannot tell that the wife loves the range but the husband is nervous about the budget.

Never let AI write a customer email you have not read and edited. Your voice, your relationship, your reputation — those cannot be outsourced.

Never quote an AI-generated spec without verification. Never let AI make promises about delivery dates, pricing, or availability that you have not confirmed in your actual systems.

The customer bought from YOU, not from a chatbot. Keep it that way.

sections.title: The AI-Assisted Daily Workflow
sections.content:
Morning: Use AI to scan your pipeline and identify today's follow-up priorities. Have it draft your Daily Five outreach messages — then personalize each one before sending.

During the sale: Use AI for real-time product comparisons when a customer asks 'what is the difference between these two?' Pull up competitive cross-references. Get the selling angles for a brand you rarely sell.

After the sale: Have AI draft the thank-you email, the quote summary, and the follow-up sequence. Edit for your voice and send.

End of day: Use AI to update your CRM notes from the day's interactions. Faster capture means better data, which means better follow-up.
